Messages.Author: tetragr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Some questions:

1. A player's Hand can be reduced to 0 size? (Say, targetting a
Methuselah with seven (or more) Aggressive Tactics?).

2. Damage that "cannot be prevented" can be "changed to" by other
cards?
Say, an Heart of Darkness can change to normal
the Daring the Dawn's (unpreventable) aggravated damage?
2a.If yes, the "changed" unpreventable damage can be then prevented,
now that the very damage's form has changed?

3. Allies can use a Channeling the Beast?

Many thanks in advance.
Aemilianus, Prince of Rome.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: R. David Zopf
Messages.Body:
IANALSJ...

tetragr...@my-deja.com wrote in message <8b8p4v$tka$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>...

>Some questions:
>
>1. A player's Hand can be reduced to 0 size? (Say, targetting a
> Methuselah with seven (or more) Aggressive Tactics?).
>

Yes.

>2. Damage that "cannot be prevented" can be "changed to" by other
> cards?

Yes.

> Say, an Heart of Darkness can change to normal
> the Daring the Dawn's (unpreventable) aggravated damage?

A valid example, I believe...

>2a.If yes, the "changed" unpreventable damage can be then prevented,
> now that the very damage's form has changed?
>

No. It is merely no longer aggravated. It is still unpreventable...

>3. Allies can use a Channeling the Beast?
>

I believe that they cannot, as they cannot pay for the strike (which costs
one blood). Some allies are given the ability to use cards of a specific
discipline, and can spend life in lieu of blood, but this card wouldn't fall
under such a ruling. Besides, Scapelli has a pretty tame "Beast" ;-)

Remember. IANALSJ

Regards,
R. David Zopf
Atom Weaver
V:EKN Prince of Charlotte, NC

> >2. Damage that "cannot be prevented" can be "changed to" by other

Correct.

> > Say, an Heart of Darkness can change to normal
> > the Daring the Dawn's (unpreventable) aggravated damage?

Yes.

> >2a.If yes, the "changed" unpreventable damage can be then prevented,
> > now that the very damage's form has changed?
> >
> No. It is merely no longer aggravated. It is still unpreventable...

Correct. It only changes in the manner specified (i.e., "aggravated"
to "normal"). Other traits ("unpreventable") are not affected.

> >3. Allies can use a Channeling the Beast?
> >
> I believe that they cannot, as they cannot pay for the strike (which costs
> one blood). Some allies are given the ability to use cards of a specific
> discipline, and can spend life in lieu of blood, but this card wouldn't fall
> under such a ruling. Besides, Scapelli has a pretty tame "Beast" ;-)

Correct.
